name: code-review
description: Reviews pull requests against our engineering checklist and flags risky changes before merge.

name: review-pr
description: Reviews the current branch or a pull request diff against the team checklist: naming, tests, error handling and migration safety. Use when the user asks for a code review or PR review.
body:
## When to use
- Before opening a pull request
- When a reviewer asks for a second opinion

## Steps
1. Collect the diff with `scripts/collect_diff.sh`
2. Check every file against `reference/checklist.md`
3. Report findings grouped by severity: blocking, should fix, nit

```bash
git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat
```

name: security-review
description: Checks a diff for injection risks, leaked secrets, unsafe deserialization and missing authorization checks. Use when changes touch auth, input handling or infrastructure.

name: code-reviewer
description: A read-only reviewer subagent that inspects changed files in parallel and returns a prioritized list of findings with file and line references.

name: review
description: Runs the full review on the current branch and posts a summary you can paste into the pull request.

name: test-writer
description: Writes and repairs unit and end-to-end tests that follow the conventions of each repository.

name: write-unit-tests
description: Writes unit tests for a function, module or diff using the test framework already in the repository. Use when the user asks for tests or coverage.
body:
## When to use
- New code without tests
- A bug fix that needs a regression test

## Rules
- Detect the framework from `package.json` before writing anything
- One behaviour per test, named after the behaviour
- Never mock the module under test

name: e2e-playwright
description: Creates Playwright end-to-end tests for a user flow, with stable selectors and fixtures. Use when the user describes a flow to cover in the browser.

name: test-engineer
description: Investigates failing or flaky tests, finds the root cause and proposes the smallest fix.

name: release-notes
description: Turns merged pull requests and commits into readable changelogs and release notes.

name: changelog-writer
description: Groups commits since the last tag into Added, Changed and Fixed, and suggests the next semver bump. Use when preparing a release.

name: release-notes
description: Drafts user-facing release notes for a version range in plain language.

name: changelog-reminder
description: Warns before a push when source files changed but CHANGELOG.md did not.

name: docs-kit
description: Writes API docs, architecture decision records and onboarding guides in our documentation style.

name: api-docs
description: Generates reference documentation from code or an OpenAPI file, with request and response examples. Use when an endpoint or SDK method lacks docs.

name: adr-writer
description: Writes an architecture decision record with context, options considered, decision and consequences. Use after a technical decision is made.

name: tech-writer
description: Edits existing documentation for clarity, structure and consistent terminology.

name: jira-sync
description: Connects Claude Code to Jira so it can read tickets, create issues from diffs and update status.

name: jira
description: MCP server for Jira: search issues, read ticket details, create issues and move them between statuses.

name: ticket-from-diff
description: Creates a well-formed Jira ticket from the current changes, with acceptance criteria and a testing note.

name: ticket
description: Shows the Jira ticket linked to the current branch and its acceptance criteria.

name: figma-to-code
description: Implements Figma frames as components that use our design system tokens.

name: implement-frame
description: Builds a component from a Figma frame link, mapping colors and spacing to design tokens. Use when the user shares a Figma URL to implement.

name: ui-builder
description: Builds and refines UI components, then checks them against the design screenshot.

name: seo-content
description: Helps editors and developers ship search-friendly articles: audits, headlines and structured data.

name: seo-audit
description: Audits an article page for title length, meta description, headings, internal links and structured data. Use before publishing or when traffic drops.

name: headline-variants
description: Suggests headline and teaser variants for an article, each within character limits for search and social.

name: copy-editor
description: Edits article copy against the house style guide and flags factual claims that need a source.

name: db-helper
description: Reviews SQL, plans safe migrations and lets Claude query a read-only Postgres replica.

name: sql-review
description: Reviews SQL queries for missing indexes, N+1 patterns and locking risks. Use when a query is slow or a pull request changes SQL.

name: migration-planner
description: Plans a zero-downtime schema migration in reversible steps with a rollback for each step.

name: postgres-readonly
description: MCP server with read-only access to a Postgres replica for schema inspection and query plans.

name: security-guard
description: Guardrails that stop secrets and dangerous shell commands before they run.

name: secret-scan
description: Blocks writes that contain API keys, private keys or tokens, and tells Claude how to use an environment variable instead.

name: block-dangerous-bash
description: Blocks destructive shell commands such as recursive deletes outside the project and force pushes to protected branches.

name: dependency-audit
description: Checks project dependencies for known vulnerabilities and abandoned packages, and proposes safe upgrades.
